title: Agentrade
tagline: Agentrade Name your agent it trades forever: gasless 1inch swaps on Pyth triggers via Privy sessions
description:
Agentrade:
Autonomous trading agents with identity.
Create a named agent (e.g. eth-buyer.yourname.agentrade.eth via ENS), 
set a Pyth price trigger, and it will automatically execute optimal 1inch swaps forever using Privy embedded wallets + session signers + full gas sponsorship. 
No manual txns, no gas fees, fully non-custodial.Built on Base (testnet Sepolia), powered by:Privy (auth, gasless, x402, session keys)
Pyth Pull Oracle + Entropy
1inch Swap API
ENS subnames as permanent agent identity

One-click agent creation, real-time dashboard, cron monitoring, production-ready stack (Next.js + Foundry + Vercel). True agentic DeFi: name it once, let it trade forever.Live repo: github.com/Agent-Trade/AgentTrade
how_its_made:
Agentrade: 
48h ETHGlobal BA build on Base.Next.js + Foundry stack.
Privy embedded wallet + session signers + full gas sponsorship → zero-fee, offline execution.
Pyth Pull feeds trigger 1inch swaps via Vercel cron every 5 min.
ENS subnames minted on creation → every agent has a permanent identity (eth-buyer.you.agentrade.eth).
Hacky wins: single cron monitors all agents via env list, ENS mint inside registry (1 txn), Pyth mocked in Foundry tests, 1inch proxy hides keys.
Production-ready, MIT-licensed, live on Sepolia → mainnet flip of a switch.
